configurations.name: preview-mock
runtimeArgs: npx vite build && MOCK_API=1 MOCK_API_PORT=8096 MOCK_MINUTE_MS=500 MOCK_SUB_DELAY_S=12 npx vite preview --port 4175 --strictPort
